prompt: Opening a milestone page, what does the team see at a glance?
explanation: The milestone page aggregates its items’ state into progress, so "are we going to make the date?" is answerable in one look — that is the whole reason to group work by milestone.

options.text: A progress breakdown — how many of its issues and pull requests are open versus closed
A list of everyone who ever starred the repository
The label definitions for the repository
